summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for BLA761113 (SARCLISA/isatuximab). Section 9 of the FDA Multi-Discipline Review, 'Advisory Committee Meeting and Other External Consultations,' records the FDA's assessment as 'Not Applicable,' and no other review document (RiskR, OtherR, Approval letter) mentions an advisory committee, vote, or meeting. There is therefore no AdComm influence on this approval.
